pages.title: Mathesis
pages.text: Leibniz dreamed of a mathesis universalis, a science of everything worked out as one calculation. Here it is: chance, shape and the infinite in a single fluid. Made in the Conceptual Singularity Compressor, with Euler's Identity as its catalyst. One of the five fluids of Pleroma.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Pleroma.
